## Master's dissertation

::: {.trabalho}
### Construções de espaços dispersos com sequências cardinais não-enumeráveis

*Constructions of scattered spaces with uncountable cardinal sequences*, in Portuguese. M.Sc. in Mathematics, IME-USP, in progress, with the defense expected in February 2027. Advisor: Christina Brech. Funded by CAPES (PROEX).

A study of locally compact, Hausdorff, scattered spaces and their cardinal sequences.
:::

## Undergraduate thesis

::: {.trabalho}
### Álgebras de Boole e a Dualidade de Stone

*Boolean Algebras and Stone's Duality*, in Portuguese. B.Sc. in Mathematics, IME-USP, 2023. Advisor: Christina Brech.

A monograph that motivates, proves and applies Stone duality between Boolean algebras and compact, Hausdorff, zero-dimensional spaces. It covers the foundations, the classical proofs of the duality, how the usual constructions behave under it, and some applications to topology and set theory.

::: {.links}
- [PDF](https://bdta.abcd.usp.br/bitstreams/74d47cdf-30c0-4269-8049-96d8059fb311)
- [USP Digital Library of Academic Works](https://bdta.abcd.usp.br/item/003181945)
:::

## Undergraduate research

Two projects advised by Christina Brech and funded by CNPq (PIBIC):

- *Boolean algebras and Stone duality*, 2022–2023. Presented at the 31st SIICUSP, USP's international undergraduate research symposium, where it received an [honorable mention](https://e.usp.br/qj7) in the international stage.
- *Projective and superatomic Boolean algebras*, 2023–2024. Presented at the 32nd SIICUSP.
